ChatPopupSeconds.Name: Chat pop-up duration (seconds)
ChatPopupSeconds.Hint: How long a new chat card stays on screen as a pop-up while the chat sidebar is closed. Foundry's default is 5. Applies to you only. Foundry V13 and later.

SheetPdfPath.Name: Blank character sheet PDF
SheetPdfPath.Hint: Your copy of the blank fillable character sheet (TBE_RPG_Character_Sheet_BW_Fillable_v13). Upload it anywhere in your Data folder and pick it here; TBE: Sheet Exchange then fills it without asking.
